fields.help: The task title, stored trimmed; a title of only spaces is refused.
fields.name: title

fields.help: The project this task belongs to, in the same workspace; when omitted a subtask takes the project of its parent and any other task lands in the hidden project for unfiled items.
fields.name: project

fields.help: The user responsible for the task, who must be the workspace owner or an active member; it stays empty unless sent.
fields.name: assignee

fields.help: The day the task is due; optional.
fields.name: due

fields.help: The milestone this task counts toward, which must be in the same project as the task.
fields.name: milestone

fields.help: The task this one is a subtask of, which must be in the same project and cannot be the task itself.
fields.name: parent

fields.help: The place of the task in its board column; the server sets it at create, ignoring a value sent, and a client may change it later.
fields.name: ordinal

fields.help: The checklist of the task as a JSON array of objects, each with text and done.
fields.name: acceptanceCriteria

fields.help: The tasks that block this one; each must be in the same project and cannot be this task, its parent or one of its subtasks.
fields.name: dependencies

fields.help: Up to 10 images or PDFs of 10 MB each; downloading one needs a short-lived file token.
fields.name: attachments

fields.help: The task text; an @mention of a workspace member notifies them.
fields.name: description

fields.help: The id of an entry in the priority list of the workspace, or empty for no priority; a priority name is refused.
fields.name: priority

fields.help: A free-text category for the task, up to 50 characters; optional, and any text is accepted.
fields.name: type

fields.help: When the task was moved to the trash, set by the server on DELETE; send it empty only to restore the task, any other change is refused.
fields.name: trashed

fields.help: The workspace this task belongs to; it may be omitted when a project is sent, and it cannot be changed afterwards.
fields.name: workspace

fields.help: The workflow status, which must be a status of the same workspace; the workspace default is used when it is omitted.
fields.name: status

fields.help: The labels on the task, each of which must be a label of the same workspace.
fields.name: labels

fields.help: When the task entered a completed status; the server sets and clears it as the status changes, a value sent at create is replaced, and a value sent on an update is refused unless the same request moves the status into or out of a completed status; a superuser may set it.
fields.name: completedAt

fields.help: The user who moved the task to the trash, set by the server; a value sent at create is dropped, and it may only be cleared on restore.
fields.name: trashed_by

fields.help: The display key such as ENG-42, assigned by the server and fixed for life, empty outside a project; a value sent is ignored at create and refused later.
fields.name: key

fields.help: The cycle the task is planned in, which must be a cycle of the same workspace; an unfinished task moves on when its cycle ends.
fields.name: cycle

fields.help: The user who created the task, filled by the server from the signed-in caller; a value sent is replaced and a later change is refused.
fields.name: author
